component.name: KYCVerificationWizard
component.business_context: Multi-step Know Your Customer verification process for user identity confirmation

constraints: Supported file types: PDF, JPG, PNG
Verification status options: pending review, approved, rejected

missing_states: loading (async submission of each step's data)
error (per-step submission failure, e.g. network error or server rejection)
empty (no file selected yet in document upload step)
file validation error (file exceeds 10MB or unsupported type)
selfie capture loading (camera initialisation or image processing)
selfie error (camera permission denied or capture failure)
step-level form validation error (required fields missing in personal info step)
Back button disabled on step 1 (no previous step)
Next/Submit button disabled while step is incomplete or loading
wizard-level error (unrecoverable failure, e.g. session expired)
accessibility_gaps: Stepper must use role=list with aria-current=step on the active step — ensure 'current' prop is updated on every step transition
Step transitions must announce the new step to screen readers via an aria-live='polite' region (e.g. 'Step 2 of 3: Document Upload')
Personal info form fields (Input components) must each have a label prop and required=true where mandatory, with errors announced via aria-describedby + role=alert
FileUpload drop zone must have role=button and keyboard activation (Enter/Space) — verify the DS FileUpload component satisfies this
Uploaded file list must be announced via aria-live='polite' when files are added or removed
File error messages (size/type violations) must be surfaced via the FileUpload error prop so they are announced via role=alert
Selfie step must provide a text alternative or aria-label for any camera preview element; if an is used for the captured selfie it must have a descriptive alt attribute
Back and Next/Submit buttons must have descriptive labels — avoid generic 'Next'; use 'Next: Document Upload' or aria-label to convey destination step
Back button must be disabled (disabled=true) on step 1 to prevent invalid navigation, not merely hidden, so keyboard users are aware of the boundary
Submit button must expose loading state via Button loading=true which disables click and renders Spinner, preventing double-submission
Verification status screen (pending/approved/rejected) must use a Badge with an appropriate variant and surrounding text that conveys the status semantically — Badge alone is purely visual
Rejected state must surface the rejection reason as readable text, not only colour-coded Badge, to meet WCAG 1.4.1 (use of colour)
Focus must be programmatically moved to the top of the new step content on step transition to orient keyboard and screen-reader users
Wizard container should carry aria-busy=true during async loading states, paired with Skeleton or Spinner components
responsive_gaps: Stepper labels may overflow or truncate on small screens (<375px) — ensure step labels are hidden or abbreviated on mobile with only icons/numbers visible
Back and Next buttons must meet a minimum 44×44px touch target on mobile
FileUpload drag-and-drop zone must degrade gracefully on touch devices where drag events are unavailable — click-to-browse fallback must be prominent
Personal info form fields must stack vertically on mobile; avoid multi-column layouts below the sm breakpoint
Selfie capture UI (camera preview) must be full-width on mobile and not overflow the viewport
Verification status card must be readable and not clip content on small screens — use Card with padding='md' or padding='lg' and ensure text wraps correctly
Modal used for confirmation dialogs (e.g. discard progress warning) must be scrollable on small viewports if content overflows
recommendations: Use Stepper with steps=[{id:'personal',label:'Personal Info'},{id:'document',label:'Document Upload'},{id:'selfie',label:'Selfie'}], current={currentStepId}, and status={stepStatusRecord} to drive the top step indicator
Use Input with label, required=true, and error={fieldError} for all personal info fields (name, DOB, address, etc.) in step 1
Use FileUpload with accept=['application/pdf','image/jpeg','image/png'], maxSizeMb=10, multiple=false, onFiles={handleFiles}, and error={fileError} for the document upload step
Use Button with variant='primary' and loading={isSubmitting} for the Next/Submit CTA to handle async submission and prevent double-clicks
Use Button with variant='secondary' and disabled={currentStep === 0} for the Back navigation button
Use Button with variant='ghost' for a 'Save & Exit' or 'Cancel' secondary action if required
Use Spinner with size='md' and label='Submitting your information' inside the loading overlay during step submission
Use Skeleton with variant='rect' and aria-busy=true on the wizard container while initial user data is being fetched
Use Card with padding='lg' to wrap the verification status screen (pending/approved/rejected)
Use Badge with variant='warning' for pending review status, variant='success' for approved, and variant='danger' for rejected — always pair with visible text label
Use Modal with title='Discard verification progress?' and onClose={handleCancel} if the user attempts to navigate away mid-wizard
Use Icon with name='check' and aria-hidden=true alongside the approved Badge for decorative reinforcement
Use Icon with name='alert' and aria-hidden=true alongside the rejected Badge for decorative reinforcement
Use Icon with name='info' and aria-hidden=true alongside the pending Badge for decorative reinforcement
